The '''LPL 2015 Spring''' was the first split of the 2015 season of the '''LoL Pro League''' ('''LPL'''), organized by Tencent Games and Riot Games from 16 January to 26 April 2015 at the Hongkou Indoor Stadium in Shanghai. Twelve teams competed in a Double Round Robin {{Abbr/Bo2}} Group Stage followed by a Single Elimination {{Abbr/Bo5}} Playoffs bracket. Four teams entered through the LPL 2015 Spring Promotion—[[Energy Pacemaker]], [[Gamtee]], [[Masters 3]], and [[Vici Gaming]]—while two teams, [[Team King]] and [[Snake Esports]], joined from the LSPL 2014 Summer season. The split awarded qualification to the Mid-Season Invitational 2015 and determined the four lowest-ranked teams for the LPL 2015 Summer Promotion Tournament. Matches were played on Patches 4.21–5.6, with [[Viktor]] disabled during the Playoffs.

==Format==
* '''Group Stage'''
** Double Round Robin {{Abbr/Bo2}}
*** A 2-0 victory gives the winning team 3 points
*** A 1-1 tie gives both teams 1 point
*** {{bgcolortext|up|''1st till 8th place''}} advance to the Playoffs.
*** {{bgcolortext|down|''9th till 12th place''}} will have to play in the [[LPL/2015/Summer/Promotion|Promotion Tournament]].
* '''Playoffs'''
** Single Elimination {{Abbr/Bo5}}
*** Winner qualifies for [[MSI/2015|MSI]]
